items.criterion: A filed booking is stored as an enquiry row carrying every submitted field.
items.judgment: The row read back matches the booking.
items.evidence: The enquiry row read from the database after one booking.

items.criterion: A signed-in reader's booking is attached to the reader's account.
items.judgment: The reader's own list carries the new enquiry.
items.evidence: The reader's enquiry list after one signed-in booking.

items.criterion: A reader asking for another reader's enquiry is answered as missing.
items.judgment: The request answers not found.
items.evidence: The enquiry read made with the second reader's token.

items.criterion: An uploaded cover is stored in the object store under the content-addressed key.
items.judgment: The object exists under works, the work id and the digest.
items.evidence: The object store listing after one upload.

items.criterion: Publishing a draft exposes the route, the record and the cover at once.
items.judgment: All three answer after the publish.
items.evidence: The route, record and media reads after one publish.

items.criterion: The seeded draft's route answers as missing to a visitor and a reader.
items.judgment: Both reads answer not found.
items.evidence: The draft route read with no session and with a reader session.

items.criterion: A draft image requested by its exact storage key answers as missing.
items.judgment: The media route answers not found for a key that exists.
items.evidence: The media read for the draft cover key.

items.criterion: Unpublishing withdraws the route, the record and every image at once.
items.judgment: All three answer not found after the withdrawal.
items.evidence: The route, record and media reads after one unpublish.

items.criterion: An unmatched path answers 404 with the not-found title.
items.judgment: The status and the title both match.
items.evidence: The response for an unknown path.

items.criterion: Every film starts muted, looping, without controls.
items.judgment: Each video element reports muted and looping.
items.evidence: The film elements on the home route after load.

items.criterion: A public page view is stored as a row with the route and the time.
items.judgment: A row appears for the route served.
items.evidence: The page view rows after one public read.

items.criterion: Seeded images exist once each as a row and as an object.
items.judgment: No seeded row or object is duplicated.
items.evidence: The media rows and the store listing.

items.criterion: A booking with an empty name is refused and files nothing.
items.judgment: The enquiry count is unchanged.
items.evidence: The enquiry rows after one refused booking.

items.criterion: Unpublishing keeps every stored object for a republish.
items.judgment: The objects remain and a republish serves them.
items.evidence: The store listing after an unpublish and a republish.

items.criterion: Unpublishing one case study renumbers no other ordinal.
items.judgment: Every other ordinal is unchanged.
items.evidence: The works list for an author before and after.

items.criterion: Uploading the same bytes twice stores one object.
items.judgment: The store holds one object for the digest.
items.evidence: The store listing after two identical uploads.

items.criterion: Removing an image removes the object from the store.
items.judgment: The object key no longer exists.
items.evidence: The store lookup after one removal.

items.criterion: The object store refuses an anonymous read of any image.
items.judgment: A direct anonymous request to the store is refused.
items.evidence: The anonymous store read for a seeded key.

items.criterion: Only an author reads the page view record.
items.judgment: A reader and a visitor are refused.
items.evidence: The page view read under three identities.

items.criterion: An author moves an enquiry to contacted, then closed.
items.judgment: The stored status follows each change.
items.evidence: The enquiry read after each status change.
